findings.mechanism: Lām attaches at the head of the nominal assertion, whose two predicates are akbaru darajatin and akbaru tafdilan.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader hears the degree and distinction claims as equally included in one emphatic assertion.
findings.containment: The emphatic scope covers both predicates without making their two measures identical.

epistemic.reason: The lām's attachment and the two-predicate nominal clause are directly supplied.

findings.title: The definite Hereafter carries both predicates
findings.claim: The definite Hereafter noun is the subject of two coordinated superiority predicates, giving the degree and distinction claims one shared horizon.
findings.mechanism: The nominative subject al-ākhirah is attached to akbaru darajatin and akbaru tafdilan in a single nominal clause.
findings.reader_payoff: Both measures describe the same known final horizon rather than introducing another worldly group.
findings.containment: The clause identifies its subject and predicates but leaves the exact extent and cause unstated.

epistemic.reason: The definite nominative subject and both predicate attachments are directly supplied in focus evidence.

findings.title: Inspection falls on how parts are ordered
findings.claim: The ayah directs attention to the relational process by which one part of a shared field is elevated over another.
findings.mechanism: Directed inspection meets the embedded manner clause, the two partitive expressions, and the preference relation. Before this contact the reading is simply that some people have more; after it the instruction is to inspect how differential ordering is produced between portions.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader notices a process of ordered difference, not only a static fact of unequal standing.
findings.containment: This attributed reading explains the focus relation without supplying a rule, cause, or specific measure for the differences.

epistemic.reason: The HFT reader identity is legacy_unbound, but each focus word index and root in the trace matches trusted QAC occurrences; its roles and before/after change remain attributed.

findings.title: The later horizon enlarges two ordered measures
findings.claim: The later horizon is asserted as greater across ordered degrees and preferential distinction, so its after-firstness opens a greater scale rather than a lesser one.
findings.mechanism: Ākhirah carries later-after-first ordering; the repeated akbaru enlarges both the degrees and the differentiating operation; darajāt supplies ordered intervals and tafdilan names their comparative force. Before this contact the reading is simply that the afterlife is greater; after it, laterness frames a scale whose intervals and differentiation are both enlarged.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader sees the second horizon as a structured scale of differentiated positions rather than an undivided claim of greatness.
findings.containment: This preserves the ordinary final-horizon sense and adds a local ordering image. It specifies no number of ranks, reason for their distribution, or literal staircase.

epistemic.reason: The HFT identity is legacy_unbound, but all four word-index/root mappings match trusted focus occurrences and the word-analysis supports independently anchor the local two-axis reading.

findings.title: Comparative favor can be pictured as distributed increment
findings.claim: Alongside its ordinary status sense, the focus preference act admits a bounded image of increment distributed unevenly among portions, with the later comparative scale larger.
findings.mechanism: The f-d-l surplus branch meets the two partitives and their ʿalā comparison, which supply portions and a measuring relation; the later akbaru forms scale up the increment and its differentiation. Before this contact, faḍḍalnā reads as honor or rank alone; after it, the relation can also be modeled as unequal increments among portions.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can picture differential preference as allocation across parts while keeping the ordinary comparison recoverable.
findings.containment: This is a focus-local model of surplus and distribution, not a claim of literal wealth transfer or an independent bounty noun; the Form II verb still predicates caused differentiation.

epistemic.reason: The exact HFT roles match focus roots and a trusted word-analysis support supplies the surplus color, but the reader identity is legacy_unbound and the material model remains an attributed analogy.
